strategy_notes.QB: Konami Code: rushing QBs (Allen, Jackson, J. Daniels, Hurts, Maye) carry a weekly rushing floor. Get one of the elite tier OR wait and stream -- avoid the pocket-passer dead zone in the middle rounds.
strategy_notes.RB: 0-PPR + 14 teams = RB scarcity is REAL. Anchor early (Hero-RB) and secure starters before the tier cliffs. Target three-down backs and goal-line roles; their floor wins standard leagues.
strategy_notes.WR: Deepest position -- you can wait if you've anchored RB. Chase target share and yards-per-route-run. In the late rounds throw darts at high-ceiling (high-variance) WRs, not safe floors.
strategy_notes.TE: Elite TE (McBride/Bowers) or punt. Avoid the TE dead zone (~rounds 6-10). If you miss the top tier, wait and take a value-vs-ADP faller.
strategy_notes.K: Streaming position. Draft last. Never reach.
strategy_notes.DST: Streaming position. Draft late, target good Week 1 matchups.

tag_legend.KONAMI: Mobile QB with a rushing floor
tag_legend.POCKET: Pocket passer — historically fades vs ADP
tag_legend.ELITE-TE: Elite TE tier — the only TEs worth taking before the late rounds
tag_legend.HANDCUFF: Backup to a bell-cow RB — league-winner if the starter goes down
tag_legend.MOBILE-QB: RB whose mobile QB siphons carries/targets/goal-line work
tag_legend.GOOD-OFF: Pass-catcher in a strong projected passing offense
tag_legend.WEAK-OFF: Pass-catcher in a weak offense (TEs here rarely hit)
tag_legend.LOW-COMP: TE with little same-team WR competition (more targets)
tag_legend.CROWDED: WR in a crowded receiver room (target competition)
